notes.title: Dive Deep into the Ratdom with the all-new Gameplay Overview Trailer!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894409/81c7518b35262e8faa48dbced12d0ef552af5757.jpg[/img]
[h2]Hear Ye, Ratkind![/h2]
The countdown is on, Warriors of the Ratdom. 🐀 [i]Tails of Iron 2: Whiskers of Winter[/i] launches in just seven days on [b]January 28th[/b], inviting you to take up arms as Arlo and brave the frozen expanse of the Northern Wastes.

To get you ready for the brutal journey ahead, we’ve unveiled the [b]Gameplay Overview Trailer[/b], a thrilling look at the game’s visceral combat, powerful magic system, and high-stakes monster hunts. Check it out now and prepare to rise to the challenge!

[previewyoutube=-mj-v3CHQK8;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]The Northern Wastes[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Ah9UaX4.gif[/img]

The vast, unforgiving [b]Northern Wastes[/b] serve as the backdrop for this epic tale. With [b]six unique biomes[/b] ranging from frozen tundras to perilous swamplands, every step of Arlo’s journey is fraught with danger. These lands are as beautiful as they are deadly, hiding secrets, treasures, and challenges for those brave enough to explore.

[h3]A Fractured Kingdom[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/gOi46nu.gif[/img]

The world of [i]Tails of Iron 2[/i] is one of struggle and survival. The devastating [b]Dark Wings[/b] have returned from myth, unleashing destruction along the Ratdom’s northern frontier. It falls to Arlo, the hardened heir of the North, to unite the scattered clans and rally them under one banner. As the new Warden of Winter’s Edge, Arlo must [b]rebuild[/b] not only his keep but also the trust of his people to stand against the returning darkness.

[h3]The Hunter and the Hunted[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/0o0TgU6.gif[/img]

[b]Monstrous beasts[/b] roam the Northern Wastes, threatening the lives of its residents. By accepting contracts from locals, Arlo can embark on [b]hunts[/b] to take down these deadly creatures. Each of these challenges is a test of strength, strategy, and survival. The rewards? Rare materials to craft powerful equipment, glory to bolster Arlo’s legend, and the satisfaction of ridding the land of its greatest threats.

[h3]A Bastion Amid the Blizzard[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/QkuA0OT.gif[/img]

Winter’s Edge, once a proud and mighty fortress, lies in ruins after the devastating assault of the Dark Wings. This ancient stronghold, nestled in the heart of the Northern Wastes, is the home that Arlo is sworn to [b]protect and restore[/b]. Rebuilding Winter’s Edge is no easy task, but it’s vital to reclaiming the kingdom’s former glory.

[h3]Weaponry and Armour[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Cg8NkFt.gif[/img]

Victory in [i]Tails of Iron 2[/i] depends on preparation. [b]Weapons and armour[/b] now come with [b]elemental buffs and resistances[/b], making [b]tactical decision-making[/b] more important than ever. Enemies have specific weaknesses, and choosing the right tools for the job can mean the difference between survival and defeat. From the [b]blacksmith’s forge[/b] to the battlefield, Arlo’s arsenal is key to his success.

[h3]The Power of the Gods[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/nc99gyv.gif[/img]

Arlo’s journey introduces a game-changing feature: the Elementa magic system. Gifted by the ancient gods, Arlo can wield the devastating powers of:

[b]Electric[/b] ⚡: Call lightning from the heavens to stun multiple enemies.
[b]Fire[/b] 🔥: Launch searing flameblasts to incinerate foes.
[b]Ice[/b] ❄️: Unleash freezing gusts to stop enemies in their tracks.
[b]Poison[/b] ☠️: Inflict lingering damage to weaken entire groups of foes.

These abilities can be upgraded throughout the game, adding layers of depth and strategy to combat. Mastering them is essential to defeating the strongest enemies and overcoming the harshest trials.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2473480/Tails_of_Iron_2_Whiskers_of_Winter?snr=2___ 
With launch day just around the corner, we can’t wait for you to step into Arlo’s boots and take on the challenges of the frozen North. From mastering brutal combat to rebuilding a kingdom and forging new alliances, [i]Tails of Iron 2: Whiskers of Winter[/i] promises an unforgettable adventure.

notes.title: Sharpen Your Axe! Brutal Gamescom Trailer Unveils Tails of Iron 2 Release Date!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40703556/f8e5e1a238bb830aa5e3f1d7c22a0e2dd9a837a5.png[/img]
[h3]Hear Ye, Ratkind![/h3]

A new saga is about to begin… We’re thrilled to announce that [i]Tails of Iron 2: Whiskers of Winter[/i] is officially launching in February 2025! Get ready to take up the mantle of Arlo, son of the Warden of the North, pick up a sharpened battle axe (or broadsword or spear… there are plenty of weapons of choice!) and defend your homeland after the devastating attack by the Dark Wings - an ancient evil from the frozen wastelands beyond.

In our brand new trailer, we’ve unveiled fresh gameplay footage showcasing Arlo’s brutal journey of survival and revenge. The Viking-esque aesthetic of this new story is emphasized by Fever Ray’s haunting 2008 track, ‘If I Had a Heart’ – we think it’s a fitting accompaniment to the harsh and unforgiving world Arlo must navigate through in the game.

[previewyoutube=Sg5FBayiuWc;full][/previewyoutube]
The new release date ensures we can provide the very best experience possible, and we absolutely cannot wait to reveal what’s in store for would-be vikings come early 2025. 

[h3]Your Feedback & Next steps[/h3]

We were truly humbled to see so many of you dive into the demo during June’s Steam Next Fest. Your enthusiasm and support means everything to us, and we’ve been listening closely to your feedback. Many of you enjoyed the new gameplay mechanics we introduced, but there was one point that needed a little attention – the weapon sharpening mechanic.

Thanks to your invaluable feedback, we’re making the following adjustments to the game at launch:

[list]
[*] Whetstones will now act more like weapon buffs; when used, they will increase the weapon's damage output for a limited time, similar to the poison mechanic in the original [i]Tails of Iron[/i].
[*] Weapons will no longer dull, resulting in bounce back and the inability to hit enemies. This has been entirely removed.
[*] Managing the ‘health’ of the whetstone is no longer a requirement.
[*] Whetstones are now purchasable at the shop and can also be found in the world and as an enemy drop.
[/list]
We believe these changes will make for a more fluid and enjoyable experience, and we’re incredibly grateful for your input, which has been essential in refining the game. With these improvements, we’re looking forward to bringing you an adventure truly worthy of the Viking sagas of old!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894409/074c7b43844cae081e1835d9d69442a8312555bd.png[/img]
[h1]Hear ye, Ratkind…[/h1]

We are truly humbled to see so many of you play the demo for our upcoming squeak-quel, [i]Tails of Iron 2[/i], during Steam Next Fest. Your ongoing enthusiasm and support mean the absolute world to us.

[h2]Your Feedback Matters![/h2]

The Steam Next Fest was a great opportunity for us to hear your honest thoughts and feedback on our upcoming action-RPG, especially considering the new gameplay mechanics we’ve added, largely based on community responses to the original game. On the whole, we’re delighted to see an overwhelmingly positive reaction, with just one element - the weapon sharpening mechanic - seeming to need a little tweaking based on popular consensus. Having taken on board all of your feedback, we’re pleased to confirm that the whetstone sharpening will receive the following adjustments ahead of the full game’s launch later this year:

[list]
[*]Whetstones will now act more like weapon buffs; when used, they will increase the weapon's damage output for a limited time, similar to the poison mechanic in the original [i]Tails of Iron[/i].
[*]Weapons will no longer dull, resulting in bounce back and the inability to hit enemies. This has been entirely removed.
[*]Managing the ‘health’ of the whetstone is no longer a requirement.
[*]Whetstones are now purchasable at the shop and can also be found in the world and as an enemy drop.
[/list]
We strongly believe these changes significantly improve the weapon sharpening mechanic, providing further accessibility and flexibility in gameplay. We’re truly grateful for your feedback, which has again proven invaluable as we continue to refine the game. And with that in mind…

[h2]Demo Extended![/h2]

Originally, the [i]Tails of Iron 2[/i] demo was only supposed to be live for the duration of Steam Next Fest. However, due to the overwhelming response and to provide more of you with a chance to play, we’re excited to announce the demo period has been extended! This gives you more time to explore, battle, and experience the opening of Arlo’s epic saga of revenge against the devastating Dark Wings.

[list]

[i]Whiskers of Winter[/i]’s ‘tail’ of Arlo’s fight against the ferocious Dark Wing Bats is an intense experience, featuring a semi-open RPG world set across six varied biomes to explore, and new animal factions to discover.

Building upon the series’ trademark hardcore combat, [i]Tails of Iron 2[/i] features enhanced weapons gameplay, including four elemental effects (fire, ice, electricity, and poison) to imbue Arlo’s arsenal with unique abilities to use against foes.

[*][b]Giant Monster Hunting Side Quests[/b] 
To tip the balance against the new fanged army of Dark Wing Bats, Arlo can track down and overcome 15 gigantic and challenging beasts to harvest their cadavers for rare upgrade materials.

[*][b]Improved base building[/b] 
Construct and upgrade the devastated settlement of Winter’s Edge to gain access to more powerful items from the smithy, tastier meals at the kitchen, a wider range of powerful traps from the shoppe, and more!

[*][b]Day and night system[/b] 
Arlo will face different foes depending on the time of day, with more enemy types added as additional monsters are hunted down and vanquished.

[h3]Greetings all Ratkind,[/h3]
A great threat looms in the North, and all that stands in its way is one Rat, hardened by the harshest of environments. Set after the bloody conclusion of the original game, [i]Tails of Iron 2: Whiskers of Winter[/i] sees Arlo, son of the Warden of the North, embark on a violent quest of ruthless revenge against the Dark Wings’ onslaught, while introducing new fearsome monster-hunting sidequests against gigantic beasts.

To aid in the pursuit of vengeance, Arlo can imbue his weapons with a range of new elemental effects and abilities, ensuring his success against the scum that plagues his lands. However, as a result of the chaos brought upon the North, Arlo must rebuild the Northern Garrison of Winter’s Edge with the use of the enhanced settlement mechanics. All the while, the region’s new protector must explore new and distinct areas of the frontier, home to a new cast of critters, some to ally with... others, to vanquish.

[i]A new and violent ‘tail’ begins…[/i]

[i]“We took on board the incredible community feedback on the original game and set about crafting a more intense experience than its predecessor. The new gameplay mechanics, the addition of monster hunting sidequests, together with improved crafting and base building, all work together to make Arlo’s crusade in the northern wastelands even more epic than King Redgi’s.” [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894409/95b0bb3290df9bd9753bc6dbfa452eba4f667842.jpg[/img]

notes.title: BEHOLD! THE LORDS OF THE FALLEN, AN ALL-NEW DARK FANTASY ACTION-RPG, UNVEILED
notes.content:
Loyal Rodents, 

A royal decree of the highest order just arrived!

With peace restored to Rat Kingdom, it’s time to leave the comforts of your throne and set a course for the war-torn world of The Lords of the Fallen - an all-new, dark fantasy action-RPG. 

The upcoming title scorched the earth last night when it was unveiled as part of Geoff Keighley’s global gaming event, Opening Night Live. Revealed in the form of a three minute cinematic trailer, it offered viewers their very first glimpse of a world shrouded in shadow and chaos, with narration by the guitar-shredding dungeon master, himself, Joseph Quinn. Bear witness to the moment below…

[previewyoutube=nPGuYZ59NV8;full][/previewyoutube]

The Lords of the Fallen introduces an all-new adventure in a vast, interconnected world, more than five times larger than the original game. An expansive RPG experience - filled with NPC quests, compelling characters, epic boss battles, and rich, immersive narrative - we rats must band together to overcome a new evil in this faroff land. 

Keep scrolling below for more information, or if you’ve already heard enough and are ready to take up arms in the name of all that is good,
 wishlist[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1501750/The_Lords_of_the_Fallen/] here. [/url]

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[i]“The Lords of the Fallen is the successor fans of the original title have always wanted,”[/i] said Cezar
Virtosu, Creative Director of Hexworks. [i]“The game is significantly larger, with a vast, interconnected dual world split between the realms of the living and dead, that players can explore alone or with friends. It's darker and more challenging, with faster soulslike combat, stronger thematic, richer narrative, deeper RPG systems, and more immersive storytelling."[/i]

Millennia has passed since the events of the original 2014 hit; the world has plunged into shadow and chaos, as the demon god, Adyr’s resurrection draws nigh. As one of the fabled Dark Crusaders, journey through both the realms of the living and the dead in a thrilling campaign, featuring colossal boss battles, fast challenging combat, memorable character encounters, and deep, immersive storytelling. Will your legend be one of light… or one of darkness?

[b]Explore Two Vast, Parallel Worlds [/b]

From the ethereal heights of Skywalk Bridge, to the decrepit depths of the Shuja swamps, carve your own blood-soaked path through two parallel worlds in an epic quest to overthrow Adyr, the tyrannical, demon god. While the living realm presents its own brutal challenges, untold terrors await in the nightmarish realm of the dead. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748078/1448c5d0d7cbc574b159fb7359d47dadd2f51620.gif[/img]

[b]Wield a Device of Ungodly Power [/b]

Lantern-bearer, you possess the ungodly power to cross between the realm of the living… and beyond.  Use this dark art to reach forgotten places, unearth fabled treasures, and even purge the very soul of your foe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748078/1499d429dd26db066a7f7d8bc92f5711279b1fc5.gif[/img]

[b]Rise from Death[/b] 

Fall in the world of the living, and rise again… in the world of the dead. As a Dark Crusader, you now have one final chance to restore your honour and claim what was lost in your living state. However, this is no easy feat, as all manner of hellish creature descends upon you. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748078/07447d18b3eda0cc414e56ebcbb7714dc730db96.gif[/img]

[b]Unite or Fight in Online Multiplayer[/b]

Adyr’s colossal Lords of Rhogar do not fall easily, but help is at hand for those whose pride permits it. Brave the entire world side-by-side with a loyal companion in uninterrupted, online multiplayer, with fitting rewards for those who complete community quests and events. Though such dealings will render one vulnerable to invasions from heroes of other realms. Art thou the hunter… or the hunted?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748078/8f1dfa1944e814f2b880bdf21bbb348ba71b918a.gif[/img]

[b]Master Fast, Challenging Combat [/b]

In a land overrun by demons, amid a world plagued by suffering, only those that master the fast challenging combat stand but a hope of survival. Choose from 100s of uniquely brutal weapons, or forgo metal for magic with devastating attacks of the arcane.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748078/2e0bbf463c90408cc8ecafd3aafd2a79c2f99373.gif[/img]

[b]Fully Customise and Develop Your Own Character[/b]

Fully customise your character’s appearance from a wide array of visual options, before selecting one of nine character classes. Whichever starting path you take, develop your character to your own playstyle by upgrading stats, weapons, armour and spells. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748078/5c1ec7d33b12fc88acb943504ddbb06f8bec6a9c.gif[/img]

[b]Key Features:[/b] 

[list]
[*] Embark upon two vast, parallel worlds - that of the living… and the dead 
[*] Master a fast, fluid and challenging satisfying tactical combat system 
[*] Wield devastating magic attacks and character buffs
[*] Invite a second player to join your campaign Explore the world side-by-side in uninterrupted, online multiplayer
[*] Encounter a wide array of characters inhabitants, eager to offer a dubious hand… 
[*] Fully customise your own unique character 
[*] Choose from 9 starting character classes, including Knight, Rogue and Fire Apprentice
[/list]

Powered by Unreal Engine 5, The Lords of the Fallen is currently in development for PC and latest-gen consoles. Follow the Steam Page to ensure you’re among the first to hear about all future updates, including a full gameplay reveal later this year.

[i]Tails of Iron[/i] uses a weapon-based levelling system. You’ll discover no less than 189 different weapons and armours as you travel the land, with each offering its own pros and cons.

Which weapon style is your flavour?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40703556/e792b309d1e506c8d5a94205db33786563f43485.gif[/img]

[h2]10 - It’s Punny[/h2]

[h2]11 - Brew Tasty Recipes[/h2]

You may not be able to pet our hero (yeah sorry about that) but you can certainly feed him some hearty meals!

[h2]12 - Epic Bosses[/h2]

We’ve added 5 more bosses in our free expansion, Bloody Whiskers. However, there are tons more in the base storyline, each with its own attack patterns and visually pleasing executions!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40703556/3162c0b43d77d21d21d94d354251f6b784be14ac.gif[/img]

[h2]13 - Alliteratively Awesome[/h2]

After playing [i]Tails of Iron[/i], some players may experience new talents and skills in RL.*

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40703556/16c1b65201d60f95ecb03bf3fb477bc2d97c4a80.png[/img]

*We have no evidence to prove that [i]Tails of Iron[/i] gifted this player with these skills. Regardless, we’re happy with the results!

[h2]14 - The Challenge You Want![/h2]

Introduced by the new expansion, you can run through [i]Tails of Iron[/i] the way you want to, thanks to the new difficulty modesEnjoy the story in Fairy Tail mode, or experience a life-changing challenge in ‘Bloody Whiskers’ mode. 

[h2]15 - Stunning Visuals[/h2]

We did a check-in on our reviews recently, and over 70% of them mentioned how much they loved the art style of [i]Tails of Iron[/i]. 
Can you see why?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40703556/631d402822f81b829efc6034d5392f1168431fb3.png[/img]

[h2]16 - We’ve Even Got a Band[/h2]

The in-game bards of [i]Tails of Iron[/i] are strewn across the land - brutal frog invasion or not - just to serve your royal eardrums! Can you really let them go unheard?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1792940/Tails_of_Iron_Soundtrack/ 

[h2]17 - You DON’T Need a High-end PC to Play![/h2]

We thought about you. And you. And yes, you too! 
We didn’t want the hardware to limit who could and couldn’t play [i]Tails of Iron[/i], so we worked closely with our QA partners to ensure optimisation was at its very best and that the game would run as smooth as warm butter.


[h2]18 - Secrets of the Land[/h2]

Consider yourself an explorer? Well, in [i]Tails of Iron[/i] you’ll get plenty of chances to excavate the land and discover the many secrets that lay in store. Perhaps you’ll even stumble across a subterranean community, very fond of neon lights. No spoilers...

[h2]19 - Equip the Best, but at What Cost?[/h2]

Adapt Redgi’s combat style to the task at hand. Heavy armour may provide better protection but can you really afford to slow down your dodge-roll?

It’s your tail at the end of the day...

[h2]20 - Lose Yourself in the Story[/h2]

Overcome your fears. Rescue your brothers. Restore Your Kingdom.

It’s your tail...

[h2]21 - FREE Content Updates![/h2]

We’ve delivered a couple of free updates since release, including the ‘Midnight Mischief’ DLC containing spooky Halloween skins. But more recently, we released the ‘Bloody Whiskers’ free expansion that introduces a whole new questline, 5 new bosses and a ton more!

[h2]22 - Craft Armours[/h2]

Not only do you get to select your armour preferences but you’ll get the opportunity to craft your very own armours, too. We’ve also added more armour with the last two updates, so we’re sure there’s an armour style out there that will suit you. (Armour, armour, armour…)

[h2]23 - Cute but Deadly![/h2]

It’s super cute, while also incredibly dark and gritty. It’s the perfect combo! 

[h2]24 - Avenge the Late King[/h2]

Who wouldn't want to avenge this old fella?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40703556/92136d2de87e60579ce56ee9847806c226edadcc.gif[/img]

Yup, true story. From Dug to Redgi, and every rat in between, they’re all inspired by the real life rats of the dev team! Here’s a stylish image of the rat pack that inspired the core characters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40703556/9c11701d9f1aae50711dbea89223089446f75787.jpg[/img]

Phew! Only the mightiest of you have reached this far, and for that we applaud you. We could get granular, but we don’t want to let loose any spoilers before you enter Rat Kingdom. Once you’ve completed [i]Tails of Iron[/i] reach out to us on social media or drop us a review to let us know what you thought. 

All the best fellow rodents, and may your tail begin...

notes.title: OUT NOW - The Great ‘Key Remapping’ Update
notes.content:
Attention, Royal Rodents!

You spoke, we listened. And today, a new decree (aka update) will roll out across the Kingdom. The version number is, let's say “overcomplicated”, so we’ll just call this the great ‘Key Remapping’ update of 2021 because let’s face it, that’s why we’re all here.

In a nutshell (mmm, [i]nut shells![/i]), this patch will deliver the following:
[list]
[*] Key Remapping for keyboard and mouse
[*] A toggle for NPC SFX
[*] Expanded controller support for PS5
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40703556/d0f73aefd136e9fe3b83a8eb9789c457cb664270.png[/img]

[h2]Key Remapping[/h2]

When creating a game, you try your hardest to get everything perfect, and really drill into every detail, whether that’s the art, the animations, audio, music, SFX (squeak!) or one of the many other numerous components. But paws held high, it turns out we overlooked one important feature many of you hold dear. So, since release, and having read all of your comments (many of which blew us away with their kind words!), we’ve worked diligently to implement key remapping on keyboard and mouse to [i]Tails of Iron[/i]. So no more excuses when Dennis the Bold repeatedly kicks your *flute whistles*! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40703556/1d3cc65abd86678b0c7fc737b4a81646a52d6150.png[/img]

[h2]Toggle for NPC SFX[/h2]

We heard you, again, and in response, have added a toggle in the settings to turn off all NPC sound effects. Flip the switch and you’ll no longer hear all the beautiful sounds of your rat brethren. Not even their heartfelt sobs, in the knowledge they’ve been forever silenced. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40703556/6d444908a4e5a4548f7f1554063c2560463671a6.png[/img]

[h2]Expanded controller support[/h2]

You should experience far fewer issues when connecting a PS5 controller now.
[i]Nintendo Switch, PS4 and Xbox controllers were already supported from day one.[/i]

That wraps this patch up for the day. We hope this makes your journey through Rat Kingdom that little bit smoother. Let’s celebrate with a nice, cool bug juice!
